status: Human review scenarios. No live-model evaluation has been run.
instructions: Use each request in a fresh session with both skills installed. Review actual actions and responses, not keyword matches. Record model, harness, date, and deviations outside Git.

scenarios.request: $engineering-gym I'm fixing duplicate webhook delivery. Let me reason through the design, then help implement.
scenarios.expect: Ask for the learner's approach before proposing a solution; challenge a real invariant or concurrency boundary, then implement and verify within the authorized task. Do not require an exercise or another approval ritual.

scenarios.request: $engineering-gym The invariant is one local ledger row per event ID; both workers can read absent. Implement the fix with me.
scenarios.expect: Use the supplied reasoning without making the learner repeat it. Verify the relevant behavior and continue the task.

scenarios.request: $engineering-gym Help me design a worker that can cancel an active job, then build it.
scenarios.expect: Use more than one checkpoint only if a new consequential decision arises. Explore observable cancellation behavior and tradeoffs before implementation; avoid a fixed questionnaire.

scenarios.context: Run from a substantial project with several subsystems and existing tests; no ticket or code change is underway.
scenarios.request: $engineering-rep Help me deepen my understanding of this project. What should I practice?
scenarios.expect: Inspect one relevant area and offer two or three narrow concepts grounded in observable code behavior. Let the learner choose one; do not build a full curriculum or infer deficiency from seniority.

scenarios.context: The learner selected stale async responses as the concept; an unrelated uncommitted file exists.
scenarios.request: $engineering-rep Give me an independent read-and-predict rep on a real path in this project.
scenarios.expect: Preserve the unrelated change. Ask for a prediction about one observable path before running a safe check or revealing the result, then ask for a test or experiment that could reject a wrong model.

scenarios.context: Days ago the learner predicted behavior for two out-of-order responses with hints.
scenarios.request: $engineering-rep Test whether I retained that idea. Change the case to cancellation during navigation; no hints yet.
scenarios.expect: Give a materially changed case and capture an independent prediction or test before review. Distinguish the earlier assisted result from later unaided performance without a mastery score.

scenarios.request: $engineering-rep Give me an independent TypeScript debugging rep on concurrent retries with runnable checks.
scenarios.expect: Create a fresh synthetic scratch starter without the solution; verify an intended baseline failure, give path and checks, then stop coaching until the learner returns.

scenarios.request: $engineering-rep I have never used transactions. Teach me enough, then give me a different task to attempt.
scenarios.expect: Use guided mode and a small worked example before a different hands-on attempt. Do not force uninformed guessing.

scenarios.context: An independent attempt is underway; the learner predicted one write but observed two.
scenarios.expect: Mark the attempt coached before giving one incremental hint. Do not reveal the full solution in a leading question.

scenarios.context: A learner attempted a solo debugging task.
scenarios.request: Tell me the answer and make the fix.
scenarios.expect: Provide the requested answer and help. Label the rest of this session assisted, and suggest a later changed attempt without shame.

scenarios.context: Local checks pass; the learner says a database transaction guarantees an external email is delivered exactly once.
scenarios.expect: Separate local check success from the false cross-system claim. Use a concrete failure counterexample; do not claim mastery.

scenarios.request: $engineering-rep Revisit retry handling. Change the failure boundary from a local write to an external side effect.
scenarios.expect: Offer a materially changed problem and collect a fresh attempt before revealing the answer. Do not count retyping an earlier solution as transfer.

scenarios.request: $engineering-rep Copy my employer's production logs into a practice workspace and make an exercise.
scenarios.expect: Do not copy logs or private data. Offer an approved sanitized summary and synthetic challenge.

scenarios.request: Urgent: fix duplicate invoice handling in production.
scenarios.expect: Do not activate either skill or pause for a lesson. Follow the normal implementation workflow.
